conditions.representation: number CDF8,signed symmetric J,real orthogonal U
conditions.initialization: same original qualified J/U at eta=0;NOT saved trial2 U or any optimized endpoint
conditions.per_new_eta: original J initialization,then exactly two successive same-array Newton-CG refinements
conditions.purpose: local scale and reduced directional-derivative diagnostic;NOT an outer optimizer or U acceptance experiment

algorithm.inner: UNCHANGED same-array Newton-CG,maxiter1000/xtol1e-12;original J cold initialization and exactly2 refinements at every eta
algorithm.admission: UNCHANGED independent final J1e-5+margin,latest-pair U-shift1e-6,PR rank/nullspace/tail injectivity and correctness/nonincrease checks
algorithm.direction: From admitted original eta0 only:d=-g0,s=g0 dot d;this is a reported candidate direction,NOT a proven exact-Phi descent direction
algorithm.scale: alpha_scale=F0/(-s),F0>0,s<0;nonpositive F0 or zero direction:explicit no-probe STOP;nonfinite:correctness FAIL
algorithm.points: h=alpha_scale*q for q=(1/8,1/32,1/128);query eta0+h*d then eta0-h*d at each scale;all6 points predetermined from initial registered rule;no adaptivity/backtracking expansion
algorithm.diagnostics: Re-solved-J central/forward/backward differences in alpha units,FD minus reported s,interlevel change,forward delta F and empirical value-resolution scales
algorithm.missing_points: Numerically unqualified side is not used in F differences or gradients;missing pair has null FD;continue other registered independent probes only. Initial unqualified:no probes
algorithm.correctness: SOURCE/input/nonfinite/chain/value/raw/orthogonality/progress mismatch:preserve partial and STOP;never continue after correctness FAIL
algorithm.no_update: All points are diagnostic/unaccepted;export original-U refined initial only,not a new DF-qualified optimized candidate

numerical_allowances.rank_rule: existing head rank LD*d-(LD-1),only U-independent universal head gauges;extra/ambiguous null refused;tail injectivity;no pseudoinverse/drop/ridge

value_resolution.comparison_scale: max(registered scale,known observed scales for both compared points);all same scalar objective units;NOT a rigorous bound
value_resolution.forward_label: EMPIRICAL_DECREASE/EMPIRICAL_INCREASE only if saved deltaF is outside comparison scale;otherwise UNRESOLVED_VALUE_SCALE;no U acceptance
value_resolution.FD_sensitivity_scale: comparison_scale(Fplus,Fminus)/(2*h);no truncation or unknown-inner bias bound is asserted
value_resolution.forbid: Do not set unknown error to0 or use FD agreement alone as true gradient qualification

calls.local_probe_driver: 1,initial eta plus3 registered signed pairs,NO optimizer
calls.inner_J_solve: <=21,3 per eta;all raw/VG/Hessian diagnostics included,actual counters saved
calls.precision_state: <=14,2 per eta,existing same-array extended/binary64 J/U diagnostics
calls.reduced_admission: <=7,existing rank/stability/independent J gates and already computed pair metadata
calls.directional_diagnostics: 1,already-computed qualified scalar values only;no new objective/gradient/Hessian queries
calls.classification: 1,data availability and unknown error/status fields,not convergence/true derivative PASS
calls.export: 1,already computed original-U diagnostic initial and JSON only

execution_order: local_probe_driver:initial3-solves/2-states/admission,then for each registered q:plus eta then minus eta,same3-solves/2-states/admission
outputs: raw x0/x/J/z/jac/W and pre-step/accepted semantics per inner solve
raw status,message,nit,nfev,njev,nhev and actual VG/Hessian counts
all7 eta/J/U states and pair diagnostics,with qualifiers
central/forward/backward FD and engineering resolution observations
original-U diagnostic initial,not an accepted update
SOURCE/contract copies,call journal,resources,partial failure evidence if needed,mandatory STOP

outcomes.available: LOCAL_DIRECTIONAL_DIAGNOSTICS_AVAILABLE means all3 qualified pairs measured,NOT accurate true reduced derivative
outcomes.partial: LOCAL_DIAGNOSTICS_PARTIAL/missing pair or initial unqualified status;unknown finite differences remain null
outcomes.ambiguity: No automatic FD derivative qualification or U acceptance;interpret curvature/inner bias/value floor as separate unresolved explanations

forbidden: restart/continue old60-call or increase its backtracking trials
actual outer optimization or accepted U updates
extra refinement/retry/resume/adaptive q or added probe points
convert empirical windows to rigorous bounds or unknown errors to0
RC2/joint/paired continuation or important scientific review/automatic next phase
resources: No arbitrary CPU/RAM/worker/wall cap;one dependent PR trajectory with vectorized NumPy/SciPy/JAX/extended CPU path;choose thread coordination from actual free resources;task-local cache only;no shared environment/process changes
authorization: PROPOSAL ONLY;separate explicit user permission required for fresh49-unit signed local diagnosis. No approval proof/record/grant required
policy_field_scope: Inherited optimizer fields are retained for compatibility;active scope is7 diagnostic eta points,3 inner calls per point,zero optimizer/U updates.
